name: [UPDATE 3] SPIKED
desc:
"Someone who can't see the opponent standing right in front of him, can't defeat the opponent that lies beyond!"

Create plays and dominate in your position. Choose the impact you want to make in SPIKED, a Roblox Volleyball game inspired by Haikyuu.

(It is recommended to play SPIKED with keyboard and mouse)

MOBILE IS HEAVILY A WORK IN PROGRESS!

PLAYER CONTROLS:

RMB - BUMP STANCE
LMB (IN BUMP STANCE) - Receive
LMB (MID-AIR) - Spike
RMB (MID-AIR) - Block
LMB (DURING SERVE) - Floater Serve
RMB (DURING SERVE) - Jump serve
Space - Jump (CHARGABLE)
Shift - Sprint
Q - Dive
V - Hold to recharge stamina
T - The Zone
1 - Weapon 1
2 - Weapon 2
F - Set forwards
R - Set backwards
M - Menu

Tags: Haikyuu, Haikyuu!!, Volleyball, VB, SPIKED
